items.title: NASA’s Hubble Views Ocean of Stars in Groundwork for Roman
items.abstract: These Hubble observations are part of a survey that will help researchers better interpret upcoming Nancy Grace Roman Space Telescope observations as they seek to characterize the stars and search for exoplanets in this busy region of our galaxy.

items.title: Most precise measurement of coherent elastic neutrino–nucleus scattering to date tightens limits on new forces
items.abstract: Neutrinos are tiny elementary particles with little mass and no electric charge. While most neutrinos pass through matter without interacting, a neutrino can occasionally scatter off an atomic nucleus, transferring a little energy to it and causing it to move.
